arxiv:2607.11098v1.title: AgentCheck: A Reproduce-Intervene-Mitigate Workbench for LLM Agents over MCP
arxiv:2607.11098v1.version_note: v3 exists; this record cites the read v1
arxiv:2607.11098v1.reading_note: Algorithm 1 changes one cached tool response. Section 6 explicitly excludes evaluation of compound and cascading failures. Retry/schema/filter wrappers are examined; this is not a published dependency-invalidation baseline.

arxiv:2608.12761v1.title: Correct Is Not Governed: Provenance Integrity in Agentic Workflows
arxiv:2608.12761v1.reading_note: Selective recovery already follows transitive declared dependencies after version changes. Full rerun is a strong safe alternative when lineage is unavailable. Contracts and declared dependencies can themselves be incomplete.

arxiv:2604.16706v1.title: Evaluating Tool-Using Language Agents: Judge Reliability, Propagation Cascades, and Runtime Mitigation in AgentProp-Bench
arxiv:2604.16706v1.version_note: v2 has a different title; this record cites the read v1
arxiv:2604.16706v1.reading_note: AgentProp-Bench studies parameter injection and propagation with simulated tools. Its interceptor combines schema/error checks, uncertainty keywords and numerical consistency; the paper separates judge validation from task outcomes.
